criteria.requirement: Safe migrations and explicit downgrade failure
criteria.reason: Current main does not expose a storage migration contract that can be verified by a truthful flutter_test. Migration fixtures and platform storage validation remain manual.

criteria.requirement: Results are deterministic and reproducible; all failures are explicit and actionable
criteria.reason: No existing migration API or fixture contract is available for deterministic automated verification.

criteria.requirement: No secrets, personal data or raw screenshots in logs/artifacts; no unapproved network egress
criteria.reason: Requires CI artifact and runtime egress review rather than a storage migration unit test.

criteria.requirement: Backwards compatibility and cross-platform behavior reviewed; no unsupported capability falsely advertised
criteria.reason: Requires platform storage validation and compatibility review not available from pure Dart tests.
